title: eulophia grantii
intro: Eulophia grantii, commonly known as the 'Grant's Orchid', is a species of flowering plant in the family Orchidaceae. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include relieving respiratory issues, fever, and gastrointestinal problems. The health benefits of Eulophia grantii are attributed to its therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and expectorant properties. The bioactive constituents responsible for these actions include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which have been studied for their potential to mitigate oxidative stress and modulate immune responses.
